Usage: open [<path>] [flags]

open shows the checkout on GitHub.

Arguments:
  <path>         File to open; the repository root when omitted (optional).

Flags:
  -h, --help     Show context-sensitive help.
  -p, --print    Print the URL instead of opening it.

Examples:
  open README.md:10
  open -p

Exit codes:
  0    opened, or printed with --print
  1    failed, or invalid arguments (then nothing was run)
